Join us for a heartfelt anniversary convoy in honour of our dear friend and cherished member of the Twisted Community, Paul (Aka Rusty), who passed away unexpectedly on Saturday 25th October 2025.

Paul was a passionate Elvis fan, adored animals, especially dogs, and was known for his kindness and care.

He left us far too soon, but his spirit lives on in the Twisted community he loved.

As a dedicated Convoy Control Manager, Paul’s enthusiasm and leadership will be deeply missed.

Let’s come together to celebrate his life and the joy he brought to us all.

---
